name: The Failure Even Death Rejects
source:
You play as a protagonist who decides to hire a hitman to end their life.The hitman accepts the job yet refuses to complete it. Instead, he stays close and interferes with the protagonist’s life, inserting himself into situations he has no business being a part of. 

At the same time, a powerful business tycoon, known as the god of the city, turns his attention toward the protagonist. His interest is impossible to ignore. 

Not only that, but the protagonist's stepbrother takes a dangerous and forbidden interest in the them. He no longer wants to remain just family.

Obsession replaces authority, and the situation escalates into something twisted and threatening.

[Edited from [url=https://bigdeal.itch.io/the-failure-even-death-rejects]itch.io[/url]]
